description: Evidence-based permissible urban heat mitigation interventions and engineering constraints per land-use parcel typology in Surat, Gujarat.
legal_disclaimer: Land-use typologies are spectral and OpenStreetMap heuristic classifications for planning exploration only. They do NOT imply legal land ownership, property title, or confirmed vacancy.

vacant_public_open_land.title: Unbuilt Open Ground (Public Greening Candidate)
vacant_public_open_land.description: Spectral site-type heuristic: low-built, low-canopy open ground suitable for municipal greening. Note: Satellite data identifies spectral openness and lack of structures; it does NOT confirm legal municipal ownership or legal vacancy, which must be verified via municipal cadastral records.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: No building rooftop structure present on unbuilt open ground.
prohibition_reasons.green_roof: Requires structural engineered building slab; cannot be placed on ground.
prohibition_reasons.shaded_parking_structure: Designated for greening and public parks rather than motorized vehicle parking.

vacant_private_land.title: Unbuilt Open Ground (Private / Non-Municipal)
vacant_private_land.description: Spectral site-type heuristic: unbuilt open plot without municipal designation. Legal ownership tenure and planned private development must be verified via municipal records.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: No permanent rooftop structure exists on open ground.
prohibition_reasons.public_park_native_trees: Private land ownership restricts permanent public municipal capital investment.
prohibition_reasons.dense_miyawaki_plantation: Private ownership tenure prevents permanent dense forest reservation.
prohibition_reasons.rainwater_fed_pond: Water retention bodies cannot be constructed on private development parcels.

park_garden.title: Park or Public Garden
park_garden.description: Existing municipal recreation grounds, botanical gardens, and neighborhood green spaces.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: Public parks lack expansive building roofs.
prohibition_reasons.shaded_parking_structure: Incompatible with municipal recreational park zoning.

water_adjacent.title: Water-Adjacent Buffer
water_adjacent.description: Parcels within 100 meters of the Tapi River, Khajod tidal creeks, or municipal lakes.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: Water-adjacent buffer zones are predominantly riparian or unbuilt embankments.
prohibition_reasons.green_roof: Riparian buffer zones do not support heavy structural roof installations.
prohibition_reasons.cool_pavement: High soil water table and tidal saturation risk destabilizing interlocking sub-bases.

residential_rcc_roof.title: Residential Engineered RCC Roof
residential_rcc_roof.description: Multi-story reinforced cement concrete slab roofs with load capacity >= 250 kg/m².

prohibition_reasons.tree_canopy: Deep taproot trees cannot be planted on elevated rooftop slabs.
prohibition_reasons.cool_pavement: Permeable pavers are intended for ground surfaces, not suspended building slabs.
prohibition_reasons.dense_miyawaki_plantation: Forest plantations require deep native ground soil.
prohibition_reasons.rainwater_fed_pond: Water bodies on residential rooftops pose critical structural hydrostatic overload and leak risks.
prohibition_reasons.public_park_native_trees: Ground trees cannot be planted on residential roofs.

industrial_shed_roof.title: Industrial Warehouse / Shed Roof
industrial_shed_roof.description: Thin corrugated galvanized iron (GI), asbestos sheets, or steel purlin industrial structures (load capacity < 25 kg/m²).

prohibition_reasons.green_roof: CRITICAL STRUCTURAL SAFETY VIOLATION: Industrial corrugated tin/asbestos sheets have live load capacity < 25 kg/m²; extensive green roofs (100-150 kg/m² saturated) cause catastrophic structural collapse.
prohibition_reasons.tree_canopy: Cannot plant ground trees on elevated metal roofs.
prohibition_reasons.cool_pavement: Pavement applies strictly to ground surfaces.
prohibition_reasons.dense_miyawaki_plantation: Cannot be planted on building roofs.

informal_settlement_roof.title: Informal Settlement Roof
informal_settlement_roof.description: High-density slum settlement dwellings with lightweight, fragile roofing (tin sheets, plastic, recycled tiles, timber rafters; load capacity < 15 kg/m²).

prohibition_reasons.green_roof: STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE RISK: Informal timber/bamboo rafters cannot support saturated soil media or drainage trays.
prohibition_reasons.shaded_parking_structure: Dense informal settlements lack dedicated vehicular parking courts.
prohibition_reasons.rainwater_fed_pond: High flood vulnerability and lack of protected catchment in informal settlements.
prohibition_reasons.dense_miyawaki_plantation: High population density leaves no contiguous plots for multi-layer dense forest.

road_corridor.title: Road Corridor & Verge
road_corridor.description: Right-of-way transport corridors, median verges, and pedestrian sidewalks.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: Road corridors contain no building rooftops.
prohibition_reasons.rainwater_fed_pond: Ponds in road rights-of-way obstruct traffic and pose road safety hazards.
prohibition_reasons.shaded_parking_structure: Road thoroughfares must maintain vehicular flow and sightlines.

parking_paved_yard.title: Parking Lot or Paved Yard
parking_paved_yard.description: Commercial, institutional, or freight parking aprons, container storage yards, and unshaded asphalt/concrete pavements.

prohibition_reasons.cool_roof: Surface parking lots have no permanent building rooftops.
prohibition_reasons.green_roof: Ground surface; requires building roof slab.
prohibition_reasons.rainwater_fed_pond: Water retention bodies conflict with parking space and freight maneuvers.
prohibition_reasons.dense_miyawaki_plantation: Dense forest clusters conflict with vehicle maneuvering requirements.

institutional_campus.title: Institutional Campus (Heuristic)
institutional_campus.description: Site classification heuristic based on OpenStreetMap educational, medical, or civic facility tags. Campus perimeter boundaries and institutional approvals require cadastral verification.

unclassified.title: Unclassified / Uncertain Land Parcel
unclassified.description: Parcels with ambiguous or unverified satellite/OSM signatures requiring an on-site structural and land-tenure survey before any capital permit or allocation.

prohibition_reasons.all: MANDATORY RESTRICTION: Site classification is uncertain. No mechanical intervention can be approved until an on-site survey verifies roof structural safety, parcel boundaries, and water availability.
